raw_text:
name: dotnet-csharp-source-generators

Guidance for creating `IIncrementalGenerator`-based Roslyn generators and consuming `[GeneratedRegex]`, `[LoggerMessage]`, and System.Text.Json source generation. Related: [skill:dotnet-roslyn-analyzers], [skill:dotnet-csharp-modern-patterns], [skill:dotnet-csharp-coding-standards].

Source generators are shipped as analyzers targeting `netstandard2.0`. **Always target `netstandard2.0`.** Use `LangVersion>latest` to write modern C# in the generator itself. Always use `IIncrementalGenerator` over the legacy `ISourceGenerator`.

Generator workflow: filter early with `ForAttributeWithMetadataName` or `CreateSyntaxProvider` and a tight predicate; transform candidates to simple value-equatable data (`record struct` or `IEquatable<T>`); group by containing type; emit deterministic output with `// <auto-generated/>`, `#nullable enable`, and `{TypeName}.{Feature}.g.cs` names. Never pass `ISymbol` or `SyntaxNode` through the pipeline (they hold the compilation alive and break caching). Same inputs must produce identical source. Report a diagnostic for unsupported shapes rather than emitting invalid code. Handle generic parameters, nested types, and the global namespace. Report errors and warnings through `SourceProductionContext` rather than throwing exceptions. Capture a `Location` for location-specific diagnostics; exclude it from value equality or report before projecting. Use `RegisterPostInitializationOutput` for code independent of user input.

Use `CSharpGeneratorDriver` to run generators in-memory and verify output; snapshot testing is available through `Verify.SourceGenerators`.

`[GeneratedRegex]`: Method must be `static partial` returning `Regex`. Place on `partial class` (or `partial struct`). `RegexOptions.Compiled` is ignored.

`[LoggerMessage]`: Methods must be `static partial` in a `partial class`. Parameters matching `{Placeholder}` supply structured values. `Exception` parameter is logged automatically (do not include in message template). Event IDs are auto-assigned if not specified; specify explicit IDs for stable telemetry.

System.Text.Json: Register all types that need serialization in `[JsonSerializable]` attributes. Use `TypeInfoResolverChain` (net8.0+) to combine multiple contexts. Required for Native AOT -- reflection-based serialization is trimmed. Polymorphic types can use `[JsonDerivedType]`.

NuGet: place generator assemblies under `analyzers/dotnet/cs/`; use `<IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>`, `<DevelopmentDependency>true</DevelopmentDependency>`, and `PackagePath="analyzers/dotnet/cs"`. For inspection, set `<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>` and `<CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>Generated</CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>`. Add `Generated/` to `.gitignore`.
